item.title: Cable Connections has been acquired by ComSonics
item.description: We are excited to announce that effective July 1st, 2015 Cable Connections has been acquired by ComSonics, Inc. based in Harrisonburg, VA. Cable Connections will continue to run as an independent operating subsidiary of ComSonics and we do not expect anything to change for our customers or our suppliers.
